description: This file defines the RestRequest class in the JiraApi namespace, providing methods for constructing and executing REST API requests with cURL, including handling authentication, request building, and response processing.

classes.name: RestRequest
classes.description: A class for managing REST API requests to Jira, including connection setup, request execution, and response handling.

methods.name: openConnect
methods.description: Initializes connection parameters and builds request body if needed.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Resets request-related properties to default state.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the HTTP request based on the specified verb.

methods.name: buildPostBody
methods.description: Constructs the request body, handling file uploads or JSON encoding.

methods.name: getResponseBody
methods.description: Returns the response body from the last request.

methods.name: getResponseInfo
methods.description: Returns information about the last response.

methods.name: lastRequestStatus
methods.description: Checks if the last request was successful based on HTTP status code.

methods.name: doExecute
methods.description: Executes the cURL request and stores response data.

methods.name: setCurlOpts
methods.description: Configures cURL options for the request.

methods.name: setAuth
methods.description: Sets authentication credentials for the request.
